title: Where will Solar Industries stock be in the next five years?
text: Where will Solar Industries stock be in the next five years?. Strong Q1FY27 results and aggressive plant expansions highlight Solar Industries' long-term potential in defence and explosives, but investors must weigh execution risks and regulatory headwinds over the next five years.
